title: Thalia to Cohost Premio Lo Nuestro 2026: ‘It’s a Celebration of Our Music, Our Roots’
summary: Dominican actress Clarissa Molina and Paraguayan model Nadia Ferreira are also cohosts of the ceremony.
contentText:
Thalia is returning to the Premio Lo Nuestro stage as cohost alongside Dominican actress Clarissa Molina and Paraguayan model Nadia Ferreira. This will mark the Mexican actress’ fourth time as cohost of the awards show.

“Premio Lo Nuestro has been part of my story for many years, and returning to this stage as a host is something that fills me with excitement,” Thalia, who’s nominated for best female combination and Mexican music collaboration of the year, said in a statement. “It’s a celebration of our music, our roots and the Latin talent that continues to shine on a global level.”

Both Molina and Ferreira are also returning as hosts. The latter will make her awards ceremony cohosting debut after hosting the pre-show Noche de Estrellas in 2025.

“I feel deeply honored to once again lead the hosting of Premio Lo Nuestro, a space I am truly passionate about and thoroughly enjoy,” Molina said in a statement. “Celebrating our music and culture each year from this stage is a reminder to never forget where we come from and to always feel proud of our Latin roots.”

Bad Bunny, Carín León, Myke Towers and Rauw Alejandro lead the 2026 nominations with 10 mentions each. They are followed by Beéle, Fuerza Regida and Karol G with eight noms; Xavi with seven; and with six nominations each are Alejandro Fernández, Elena Rose, J Balvin, Maluma, Morat and Shakira.

Voting will be open to fans until Jan. 26 at the Premio Lo Nuestro website . The awards show will air at 7 p.m. ET on Thursday, Feb. 19, on Univision, UNIMÁS and Galavisión, and will stream on VIX across the U.S. and most Latin American countries.
